//: Typecheck-only project that ADDS this workspace's test files back in.
`tsconfig.json` excludes `src/**/*.test.ts`, and Vitest only TRANSPILES tests,
so a type error inside a test used to be invisible until it failed at runtime.
`pnpm typecheck` runs `tsc -b` and then tools/scripts/typecheck-tests.mjs, which
checks every workspace that has this file.
It extends the workspace's OWN config on purpose: packages/core extends
tsconfig.core.json, which removes the DOM lib to keep core browser-free. One
root-level project would hand core's tests the DOM back.
composite is turned off so this pass can never write build info or declarations —
a checker that litters is a checker people stop trusting.
